product_metadata.title: ZVP Flexible Plastic Cutting Board Set of 8 Gradient Color, Colorful Chopping Boards, BPA Free Mats, Non-Slip, Dishwasher Safe, 15x12 Inch, Gray Neutral Colors
features: Gradient Color: Unique color gradient style delivers a charming appearance. Each set includes 8 gradient colors: 1 white, 1 black, and 6 different shades of gray, from light to dark. Decorative Black, White, and shade of gray will beautify your kitchen.

Anti-Slip: Unlike other chopping boards, our cutting boards have non-slip textures on the surface to prevent smooth food from moving, reduces knife marks, and keep knives stable. The waffle texture with rubber coating on the bottom grips the countertops better and won’t slide around.

Flexible: The set of cutting boards is made of BPA-free material. Durable, light, and bendable. It is easy to put chopped food into different containers with no food or liquid falling. Sized 15"×12", they are dishwasher safe and easy to store.

Durable: Made with premium material, these cutting boards are thick, durable, and built to last. They won’t warp like other plastic cutting mats. Upgrade your kitchen with these flexible, space saving, durable plastic board sets.
Good Service: We are so confident that you will be satisfied with our product. If you have any issues, don’t hesitate to contact us, we will be at your service within 24 hours
